name: speech-voice-clone
description: Speaks your agent's replies in your own cloned voice, on this machine's NVIDIA GPU, with an open-weight model: Qwen3-TTS, Breeze TTS 2, VoxCPM2, Fish Audio S2 Pro or Chatterbox. No account, no key and no cost per character.

setup.title: Check the GPU
setup.detail: The models run on an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA, on Windows or Linux. Qwen3-TTS peaked at 4.4 GB of video memory and VoxCPM2 at 6.1 GB in testing; Fish Audio S2 Pro needs a card with at least 12 GB.

setup.title: Add your voice
setup.detail: Record 10 to 30 seconds of the voice speaking naturally, with no music or noise. Save it as <name>.wav in the voices folder, and its exact words as <name>.txt beside it; <name> becomes the voice id. The voices folder is <engine home>/speech/voice-clone/voices, or voices/ under DIMENSION_VOICE_CLONE_HOME when that is set. Clone only a voice you have the right to use.

setup.title: Choose it in a voice profile
setup.detail: A voice profile picks it by naming provider voice-clone, a model (qwen3-tts, breeze-tts-2, voxcpm2, fish-s2-pro or chatterbox) and your voice id. The my-voice profile shipped with this pack speaks with Qwen3-TTS in a voice named me. Each model downloads when you press Download for it in the voice settings: its Python environment and weights, 8 to 19 GB depending on the model.
